It is non-toxic and non-flammable but dissociated by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>UV</mi></math>-radiations in stratosphere. The intermediates formed initially from the gas <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>'</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo>'</mo></math> are:

solution.text: The gas is Chloro-fluoro carbon. In presence of UV radiation it follows free radical mechanism. Formation of free radical as intermediate occurs due to homolytic fission of C-Cl bond.
